routes.name: Selee
routes.desc: The leftmost line on 'One-Two-Three', just left of 'Samiboy'. 1 titanium bolt, 3 slings.

routes.name: Ramazon
routes.desc: Directly left of 'Kratoy', climbing the left side of the cave. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Kratoy / Lady Boy
routes.desc: The original line starts inside the cave, moving out right towards the big hole. Rebolted further to the right, climbing up straight on the right side of the cave. Titanium bolts and slings.
routes.setter: Alex Wenner, Somjit Nigwari & Vitsaanu Rachsang, 1993

routes.name: One Thousand Knives

warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.

routes.name: Lucky
routes.desc: Variation of 'One Thousand Knives'. Shares the start, then further left to a separate anchor. Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb unless rebolted!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.
Climbing: Do not climb unless rebolted!

routes.name: La Riba
routes.desc: Second pitch of 'Kratoy', climbs straight up. Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb unless rebolted!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.

routes.desc: Righthand second pitch of 'Kratoy'. Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb unless rebolted!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.

routes.setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber & Robert Baier, 2006

routes.name: We Sad
routes.desc: 5 titanium bolts, 3 slings.
routes.setter: Barry Chamber, Leni Reeves & Vitsaanu Rachsang, 1993

routes.name: Gandalf
routes.desc: Second pitch of 'We Sad'. Starts a little bit up right on a separate belay anchor. Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb unless rebolted!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.
Climbing: Do not climb unless rebolted!

routes.name: Knights in White Satin
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Big Shit / Flying to the Stars
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Make a Way'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Make a Way
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Big Shit', then veers right about halfway up. Shares anchors with 'Confusion'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Quarks
routes.desc: Short, crimpy moves to a generous finishing sequence if you hit the moves right. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Confusion
routes.desc: Shares the start with the popular guiding route 'King Cobra' and 'Orientales'. Then traverses and continues left to the anchor of 'Make a Way'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Orientales
routes.desc: Excellent long route that seems to get very little traffic. Start as for 'Confusion' and 'King Cobra', but then straight up after the traverse to the left. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: King Cobra
routes.desc: Guiding route through the corner. It hardly gets more polished than this! Shares the start with 'Confusion' and 'Orientales'. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Massage Secrets
routes.desc: Only P1 and P2 can be climbed. P3 is on old expansion bolts and climbs on loose rock. 1. Used for guiding as a short easy single-pitch climb. 4 titanium bolts. 2. Link this pitch with P1 for a 30m single-pitch climb. Skip the intermediate anchor about halfway, which has been set up for 'Beginner'. 7 titanium bolts. 3. Do not climb! Old protection and loose rock.
warnings: Fixed Gear: P3 is on old expansion bolts and climbs on loose rock.
Climbing: Do not climb!
Rock: Old protection and loose rock.

routes.name: Beginner
routes.desc: Easy variation of 'Massage Secrets' P1 and P2. Shares the same start, then moves right to jugs and up to big ledge halfway up P2 with an additional intermediate anchor. Used for guiding. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Short and Savage
routes.desc: Short climb up the steep face. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Giggerig for Climbing
routes.desc: Another short and easy line used for guiding. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Ling Noi / Little Monkey
routes.desc: Another guiding route. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Climbing School
routes.desc: Farthest climb to the right on 'One-Two-Three' wall. Not rebolted with titanium. 3 stainless steel glue-in bolts, 2 slings.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Not rebolted with titanium. 3 stainless steel glue-in bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Long Live the Herm
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Blue sling is worn out and needs replacement! Share anchor with Be Careful

routes.name: Be Careful
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Long Live the Herm'.
